assertions: resolves the ticket via pm.get_ticket before posting
comment uses the DONE / WORKING ON / BLOCKED ON format with hierarchical numbering
sections with no items are omitted entirely
does not change ticket status, assignee, labels, or description
reports the ticket identifier and full URL after posting

evals.expected_output: Infers the ticket from the branch name or conversation; asks if ambiguous
assertions: checks the current branch name for a ticket ID
falls back to the ticket discussed in conversation

evals.prompt: /tickets-status-update PROJ-123 (session context: code written but tests never run)
evals.expected_output: Reports the work under WORKING ON, not DONE
assertions: work without verification evidence is listed under WORKING ON

evals.prompt: /tickets-status-update PROJ-123 (session context: a test fails due to an obvious one-character typo that was found but not yet fixed)
evals.expected_output: Reports the failing state without touching code
assertions: no files are edited and no state-changing commands are run
no builds, tests, or installs are started to freshen evidence

evals.prompt: /tickets-status-update PROJ-123 (session context: dependency install failed repeatedly, goal abandoned)
evals.expected_output: BLOCKED ON section with per-attempt detail
assertions: each attempt lists Expected Result and Observed Result

includes Criticality Assessment and probability-weighted Potential Alternatives
